purpose: Provide a pricing policy service that computes shopping cart price quotes and a simple PriceQuote data object for returning computed totals.
components: PriceQuote: dataclass value object holding subtotal_cents, discount_cents, tax_cents, total_cents, coupon
PricingPolicy: service encapsulating pricing rules and quote orchestration
internal_structure: The module defines a value object (PriceQuote) and a policy service (PricingPolicy). PricingPolicy holds policy configuration (tax_rate_bps and a coupon code map) set on construction, and exposes quote as the primary operation. quote coordinates internal helpers: calculate_subtotal derives a subtotal from items/products, apply_coupon computes and caps a discount from the configured mapping and customer context, calculate_tax computes tax from the taxable amount, and quote assembles the result into a PriceQuote.
module_mechanism: Consumers construct PricingPolicy with a tax rate and coupons mapping; the initializer validates and normalizes configuration. At runtime, clients call quote with customer, cart items, price lookup, and an optional coupon. The module computes subtotal, discount, and tax, then returns a PriceQuote. Other parts of the system (e.g., services) depend on this module as the pricing provider.
inputs: products price map (Dict[str, commerce_ops.models.Product]) for quote/calculate_subtotal
coupon code (str or None) for quote/apply_coupon
side_effects: Stores tax_rate_bps on the PricingPolicy instance during __init__
Normalizes coupon keys to uppercase and stores the mapping during __init__
No external I/O, network, or persistence effects in evidence
errors: ValueError: tax rate cannot be negative (initialization).
AttributeError: coupons does not provide an .items() method (initialization).
AttributeError: coupon code lacks .upper() during coupon key normalization (initialization).
AttributeError: item missing required attributes or sku lacks upper() (calculate_subtotal).
KeyError: SKU not found in price lookup (calculate_subtotal).
TypeError: Non-numeric qty or price causes arithmetic failure (calculate_subtotal).
AttributeError or TypeError: coupon.upper() unavailable or failed (apply_coupon).
ValueError: taxable amount cannot be negative (calculate_tax).
initialization_order: Instantiate PricingPolicy (__init__) to validate tax_rate_bps and normalize coupons before calling quote
Coupons normalization and policy state setup occur during __init__
summary: Provide a pricing policy service that computes shopping cart price quotes and a simple PriceQuote data object for returning computed totals.
